summary: Implementation plan created for collapsing the three Brouwerian completeness modules (1,747 lines) into one parametric development over the AlgEvaluate/AlgTValid substrate. Five phases (4 dependency waves): (1) add ConjImpAxioms 5-field class + MinimalAxioms extends it + 3 fragment instances; (2) relocate BrouwerianBotEvaluate/BrouwerianBotValid/embedding lemmas to substrate + 2 definitional bridge lemmas (independent of Phase 1, parallelizable); (3) generalize HilbertLindenbaum meet-fragment lemma bounds from [MinimalAxioms] to [ConjImpAxioms] and add one BrouwerianSemilattice instance with an EARLY scoped lake build to verify the TOP RISK instance diamond (GHA vs BSL on the same algebra type), Approach B fallback = self-contained Algebra/BrouwerianLindenbaum.lean; (4) generic soundness (5 schema lemmas + per-tier cases wrappers since cases h_ax needs the concrete inductive + efq) + generic truth lemma + generic completeness; (5) recover all three tier theorems as corollaries preserving 8 load-bearing public names + full public surface, keep all three filenames as thin re-export shims, full CSLib CI gate. Net ~-1000 lines, no new axioms, no sorry. Two research open questions resolved during planning: IsOrBotFree_implies_IsOrFree already exists (FragmentPredicates.lean:85); MinimalAxioms lives in NaturalDeduction/Equivalence.lean. Effort 9h.
next_action_hint: Run /implement 367 to execute the plan. Phase 1 and Phase 2 are independent (wave 1) and may run in parallel. The critical gate is Phase 3's EARLY scoped lake build verifying no BrouwerianSemilattice/GeneralizedHeytingAlgebra instance diamond on HilbertLindenbaumAlgebra; if it bites, switch the BSL instance to the self-contained Approach B module Algebra/BrouwerianLindenbaum.lean. Final phase must keep all three original filenames as thin re-export shims and pass lake build + lake test + lake exe checkInitImports + lake exe lint-style + lake shake.
risks: TOP RISK (R1): instance diamond - HilbertLindenbaumAlgebra Axioms would carry both BrouwerianSemilattice (via ConjImpAxioms) and GeneralizedHeytingAlgebra (via MinimalAxioms) for full-axiom Axioms; le/inf/himp are the same underlying functions so should be defeq, but Phase 3 verifies with an EARLY scoped lake build before anything depends on it. Fallback = Approach B self-contained Algebra/BrouwerianLindenbaum.lean (saves ~250 fewer lines).

R2: MinimalAxioms extends ConjImpAxioms must keep the 3 existing instances (MinPropAxiom/IntPropAxiom/PropositionalAxiom) elaborating; fallback = standalone instance [MinimalAxioms A] : ConjImpAxioms A.

R7: public-surface erosion - Phase 5 re-exposes the full public surface and diffs the name set; the 8 externally-referenced names are a hard build gate.
